note: The edits of assets/models/dog/dog-arms-clip.glb against dog-arms.glb, in the units of the studio (README.md, "dog-arms-clip.glb"). Each move takes the vertex at `from` on the welded mesh to `to`. The rig reads this file as weightMoves of tools/mesh-rigs/dog.json, so that each moved vertex keeps the weight row of its place `from` in dog-weights.json.
